headline: Application role would gain read/write access to all S3 buckets in the account instead of just the data bucket

findings.evidence_ref: In variables.tf, the `app_data_bucket_arns` default changed from `["arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data", "arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data/*"]` to `["*"]`
findings.explanation: The application role now has explicit permission to read and write every S3 bucket in the account. This violates least-privilege principle: if the application is compromised, an attacker gains access to all company data, not just the analytics bucket it legitimately needs.
